store_description: Keep {{store}} records linked directly to processed paddy bills from the active season.
store_form_description: Select a processed paddy bill and take its date, variety, weight, and owner automatically into {{store}}.
store_sale_form_description: Select a processed paddy bill and record the sale amount. Route the received money to cash or to a selected Saraf ledger.
store_form_source_hint: The selected Process record will provide the processed bill number, date, variety, weight, and owner name automatically.
no_active_season_store_hint: You need an active season before adding store records.
waste_store_description: Keep Waste records linked directly to processed paddy bills from the active season.
waste_store_coming_soon: Waste records can now be added from Process or directly from this page.
process_outputs_after_completion_hint: Add to store and add to rice are available only after Process Completed.

process_variety_summary_description: Processed quantity, source stock, and remaining available stock by paddy variety.
process_rice_description: Record rice output that comes directly from paddy process without owner fields or customer ledger activity.
process_rice_list_readonly_description: View rice extracted from completed paddy processes. This list is read-only.
process_rice_add_from_paddy_process_hint: To add process rice, open Paddy Process, complete a process, then use Add to rice on that process row.
process_rice_form_description: Enter the rice quantity extracted from the completed process. The rice variety matches the processed paddy bill and updates process rice records and rice stock.
process_rice_variety_from_process_hint: Rice variety is taken from the processed paddy bill (same category as the process).
recent_processes_description: The 10 most recent process records — same data as the Records page.
farmer_owned_paddy_description: Record farmer-owned paddy exchange for the active season. Rice owed to the farmer is tracked on the farmer customer ledger only—not deducted from rice warehouse stock.
farmer_owned_paddy_form_description: Enter paddy received and rice to return (rice letter). Amounts post to the linked farmer account ledger; physical rice stock is unchanged.
farmer_owned_rice_ledger_hint: The rice variety and quantity you enter are recorded as an obligation on the farmer customer account. They do not reduce rice warehouse or rice sales stock.
farmer_owned_paddy_season_hint: Each farmer-owned paddy exchange is automatically linked to the current active season.
farmer_owned_paddy_exchange_hint: Farmers are paid in rice, not cash. The paddy quantity must always be greater than the rice quantity, and the rice is deducted from the selected variety stock.
no_active_season_farmer_paddy_hint: You need an active season before adding farmer-owned paddy exchange records.
rice_warehouse_description: Record rice warehouse stock and keep every entry attached to the currently active season.
rice_dashboard_description: Track live rice stock, outward issue activity, payment exposure, and variety balance for the current active season.

rice_in_chart_description: Rice warehouse entries received during the selected period.

store_dashboard_description: Overview of inventory by store type and variety (from Process) for the active season.
store_inventory_description: Entries moved from Process into {{store}}. Totals by variety are shown above.
store_variety_stock_description: Stored in the database per variety (from Process). Totals update when you add entries from Process.
store_pooled_stock_description: All varieties are combined here. Sell from this total without choosing a variety.

store_recent_entries_description: Latest entries added to store from Process.

store_variety_sale_bill_hint: Bill number is assigned automatically when you save.

store_recent_activity_description: Latest store entries and sales for the active season.
store_stock_form_hint: This adds the processed bill into store inventory with Stock status. Enter the weight to allocate (not auto-filled). Sell it later from the store table.
store_sale_table_description: Entries added from Process appear here as Stock. Use row actions to sell a selected entry.
rice_sales_description: Record rice sold to buyer customers and a stocked variety; bill numbers are generated automatically. Sold quantity reduces the same rice stock used on the rice dashboard. Click a row to open that buyer’s account ledger (print, share, or download the ledger there).
rice_sales_form_description: Select a buyer customer, a rice variety that currently has available stock, enter quantity and sale date. The bill number is assigned automatically when you save (season code + RS + sequence, same style as company paddy warehouse bills).
rice_sale_bill_auto_hint: Assigned automatically on save using the active season code (for example CODE-RS-1, CODE-RS-2). The season must have a code set.
rice_sales_season_hint: Each rice sale is linked to the current active season and reduces available stock for that variety.
no_active_season_rice_sales_hint: You need an active season before recording rice sales.
rice_charity_description: Record rice given as charity from warehouse stock. No payment is collected; the quantity is deducted from available stock for the selected variety.
rice_charity_form_description: Enter the recipient name, select a rice variety with available stock, and enter the quantity and date. Bill numbers are assigned automatically (season code + RC + sequence).
no_active_season_rice_charity_hint: You need an active season before recording rice charity.
rice_charity_season_hint: Each rice charity record is linked to the current active season and reduces available stock for that variety.
rice_charity_bill_auto_hint: Bill number is assigned automatically on save (season code + RC + sequence). The season must have a code set.
rice_charity_no_payment_hint: No payment is collected. The rice quantity is deducted from warehouse stock.
ledger_entries_description: Warehouse activity and manual settlement rows are listed together here.
buyer_ledger_entries_description: Purchases for this buyer (rice sales and store sales) appear as rows. Any other ledger rows for this customer are included as well.
paddy_seller_balance_by_currency_descrip: Each currency is calculated separately. If you paid more than the paddy purchase total, the extra amount is shown as seller owes us.
paddy_seller_no_currency_balance: No paddy purchase or payment activity with a currency yet.
rice_seller_balance_by_currency_descript: Each currency is calculated separately. If you paid more than the rice purchase total, the extra amount is shown as seller owes us.
rice_seller_no_currency_balance: No rice purchase or payment activity with a currency yet.
buyer_balance_by_currency_description: Each currency is calculated separately. Only your own payments (Amount to pay) count here — on-behalf transfers are tracked separately.
buyer_no_currency_balance: No sales or payment activity with a currency yet.

farmer_rice_return_wrong_variety: Select a rice variety that still has an outstanding obligation for this farmer.
farmer_rice_return_exceeds_remaining: Return quantity exceeds the remaining rice obligation for this variety.

employee_form_description: Save employee details, salary, and work status for the active season.
employee_season_hint: Each employee is automatically linked to the current active season and gets a salary ledger.
no_active_season_employee_hint: You need an active season before adding employees.
add_salary_payment_description: Record a salary payment for the selected Shamsi month. You can pay the current month, future months in advance, or a partial amount. Mid-month hires are pro-rated by Shamsi day. Payments made before the last day of that Shamsi month are marked as advance.
employee_salary_route_cash_hint: Paid in cash from the business (no Saraf ledger entry).
employee_salary_route_saraf_hint: Paid through a Saraf; the amount is recorded on that Saraf’s ledger (same as rice sales and paddy paid from Saraf).
add_salary_deduction_description: Record a salary deduction for this employee for the selected salary month.
salary_ledger_entries_description: Every salary payment recorded for this employee appears here.
employee_ledger_entry_edit_description: Update this salary payment or deduction.
employee_ledger_entry_delete_confirm: Delete this salary ledger entry? Linked cash or Saraf records will also be removed.
ledger_pdf_share_fallback: PDF sharing is not supported on this device. The ledger PDF was downloaded instead.
salary_ledger_share_fallback: PDF sharing is not supported on this device. The salary ledger PDF was downloaded instead.
add_employee_credit_repayment_descriptio: When an employee was overpaid and leaves (or settles credit), record the amount they pay back in cash or to a Saraf. Cash increases the cash balance; Saraf increases that Saraf’s ledger.
employee_credit_repayment_route_cash_hin: Collected in cash — the amount is added to business cash.
employee_credit_repayment_route_saraf_hi: Paid to a Saraf — the amount is added to that Saraf’s ledger.
salary_prepaid_hint: This Shamsi month was paid in advance. Payable this month is zero when the month arrives.
salary_prorate_hint: Salary is calculated for {{days}} of {{totalDays}} Shamsi days in this month, from the hire date through today.
employees_dashboard_description: Track salary progress for the current Shamsi month, see who has been paid, who is remaining, and how much salary is still needed.
no_active_season_employee_dashboard_hint: There is no active season yet, so the employee dashboard cannot show current salary activity.
employee_we_owe_this_month: Extra paid this month (we owe employee)
employee_salary_balance_description: If you pay more than the payable salary for a month, the extra amount is tracked as credit we owe the employee (similar to Jwali overpayment). Remaining salary and credit are calculated separately. When the employee leaves or settles, collect the credit via cash or Saraf.
salary_from_hire_hint: Total salary from hire to now is day-based: hire month starts on the hire date, completed months are full, and the current month runs through today.
search_employee_salary_status: Search employee by name, number, position, or phone
paid_employees_description: Employees whose current month salary has been fully paid.
remaining_employees_description: Employees who still have salary remaining for the current month.
all_employees_paid: All employees have been fully paid for this month.
no_paid_employees_yet: No employees have been fully paid yet for this month.
jwali_description: Manage Jwali records for the active season and open each Jwali ledger account.
jwali_form_description: Save Jwali name, phone number, address, and optional notes for the active season.
jwali_season_hint: Each Jwali is automatically linked to the current active season and gets a ledger account.
no_active_season_jwali_hint: You need an active season before adding Jwali records.
jwali_ledger_entries_description: Every Jwali carrying entry (bags x rate) is listed here.
add_jwali_entry_description: Record carried bags and payment rate for this Jwali.
jwali_payments_description: Amounts paid to this Jwali, either from business cash or from a Saraf ledger.
add_jwali_payment_description: Record an amount paid to this Jwali. Choose whether it was paid by cash or by Saraf.
pay_on_behalf_of_other_buyer: Pay on behalf of another buyer
buyer_transfer_balance_description: Send an amount from this buyer to another buyer. No cash or Saraf entry is created.
buyer_transfer_balance_hint: The amount reduces this buyer's Still Owes and is added to the receiver's Buyer Still Owes. Both ledgers keep a linked entry.
buyer_debit_credit_description: Adjust this buyer's collection balance for amounts already settled with the buyer. No cash or Saraf entry is created.
buyer_debit_credit_hint: Debit increases Still Owes. Credit increases Collected and reduces Still Owes. Both are tracked in Collection balance by currency only.
seller_debit_credit_description: Adjust this paddy seller's balance for amounts already settled with the seller. No cash or Saraf entry is created.
seller_debit_credit_hint: Debit increases We Owe Seller. Credit increases Paid and reduces We Owe Seller. Both are tracked in balance by currency only.
seller_transfer_balance_description: Send an amount from this paddy seller to another paddy seller. No cash or Saraf entry is created.
seller_transfer_balance_hint: The amount reduces this seller's Seller Owes Us and is added to the receiver's We Owe Seller. Both ledgers keep a linked entry.
seller_payment_validation_select_seller: Select the paddy seller to transfer to
seller_transfer_paid_by_currency_descrip: Amounts you transferred to other paddy sellers, tracked separately by currency.
seller_transfer_received_by_currency_des: Amounts transferred from other paddy sellers. These increase We Owe Seller and are tracked separately by currency.
seller_no_transfer_paid_activity: No transfers to other paddy sellers recorded yet.
seller_no_transfer_received_activity: No transfers received from other paddy sellers yet.
buyer_balance_transfer_hint: On-behalf amounts move balance between buyer accounts only. They are not added to Cash or Saraf. The receiver's Still Owes increases by the transferred amount.
buyer_pay_on_behalf_by_currency: Pay on behalf of other customers
buyer_pay_on_behalf_by_currency_descript: Amounts you paid for other buyers, tracked separately by currency.
buyer_received_on_behalf_by_currency_des: Amounts transferred from other buyers. These increase your Buyer Still Owes and are tracked separately by currency.
buyer_no_received_on_behalf_activity: No payments received from other buyers yet.
buyer_self_payment_collection_descriptio: Only the amount after deducting on-behalf (same currency) is recorded in Cash or Saraf.
buyer_payment_total_hint: Enter the full amount received. If you pay on behalf in the same currency, that portion is deducted from your collection balance.
buyer_payment_net_collection_hint: Collection balance and Cash/Saraf will record {{net}} ({{total}} minus {{onBehalf}} on behalf).
jwali_payment_route_cash_hint: Deducted from business cash (included in General Dashboard cash out). Select the currency for this payment.
jwali_payment_route_saraf_hint: Deducted from the selected Saraf ledger in the chosen currency (not from business cash).
jwali_balance_by_currency_description: Each currency is calculated separately. If you paid more than the Jwali charge total, the extra amount is shown as Jwali owes us.
jwali_no_currency_balance: No Jwali charges or payments with a currency yet.
jwali_validation_positive_whole_number: Must be a positive whole number
sarafi_description: Manage Saraf (money exchange) contacts for the active season and open each cash ledger.
sarafi_form_description: Save Saraf name, phone number, address, and optional notes for the active season.
sarafi_season_hint: Each Saraf is linked to the current active season and receives a ledger for cash given in your currencies.
no_active_season_sarafi_hint: You need an active season before adding Saraf records.
sarafi_ledger_entries_description: Cash given to or withdrawn from this Saraf is recorded here, by currency.
add_sarafi_cash_entry_description: Choose cash in (given to the Saraf) or cash out (withdrawn from the Saraf), then enter the amount, currency, and date.
sarafi_currency_breakdown_description: Running totals of cash given and withdrawn, grouped by currency.
sarafi_currency_separate_hint: USD and AFN (and other currencies) are kept separate. Amounts are never converted or added across currencies.
rice_sale_charges_amount_only_hint: Enter amounts only. Payment route and currency are set below.
rice_sale_payment_applies_to_all_hint: Payment route and currency apply to rice, loading, and bags when money is collected.
rice_sale_invoice_total_hint: Rice amount + loading amount + rice bags amount. Each line can use its own currency when collected.
rice_sale_charge_route_cash_hint: Collected amounts are recorded as cash in on the Cash dashboard in the selected currency.
rice_sale_charge_route_saraf_hint: Collected amounts are recorded on the selected Saraf ledger in the selected currency.
rice_sale_pay_cash_hint: Buyer pays the full sale amount in cash now.
rice_sale_pay_paid_hint: Full amount is settled (bank transfer, credit settled, etc.).
rice_sale_pay_partial_hint: Record how much was received; the rest stays on the buyer account.
rice_sale_pay_remaining_hint: Full amount remains to be collected later.
rice_dashboard_outstanding_combined_hint: Stock purchases still owed plus buyer sale balances not yet collected.
rice_sale_route_cash_hint: Collected amounts are recorded as cash in on the Cash dashboard.
rice_sale_route_saraf_hint: Same dashboard totals, plus a cash line on the selected Saraf ledger for the amount collected now.
paddy_seller_route_cash_hint: The amount paid now is deducted from Cash, recorded on the paddy seller ledger, and shown on the paddy warehouse dashboard.
paddy_seller_route_saraf_hint: The amount paid now is deducted from the selected Saraf ledger and recorded on the paddy seller account.
paddy_seller_route_remaining_hint: Select Paid or Partial paid to choose Pay in Cash or Paid by Saraf.
expense_route_cash_hint: Records the expense and posts a cash-out entry in the Cash module for the selected currency.
expense_route_saraf_hint: Records the expense and posts a deduction on the selected Saraf ledger in the same currency.
expense_settlement_direct_hint: Pay immediately from Cash or Saraf. No vendor ledger entry is created.
expense_settlement_vendor_hint: Record the expense on the selected vendor ledger. Choose paid, partial paid, or remaining, then pay from Cash or Saraf when applicable.
expense_validation_select_vendor: Select a vendor when dealing with a vendor
expense_validation_payment_type_required: Payment type is required for vendor expenses
expense_validation_partial_paid_amount: Paid amount must be greater than 0 and less than amount
expense_validation_saraf_remaining: Pay from Saraf is not available when nothing has been paid yet
expense_validation_currency_required: Currency is required when recording a payment
expense_validation_select_saraf: Select a Saraf when paying from Saraf
vendor_balance_by_currency_description: Expense totals and payments are tracked separately for each currency.
vendor_no_currency_balance: No vendor expense or payment activity yet.
customer_vendor_payment_description: Record a payment to this vendor with paid, partial paid, or remaining settlement.
debtor_balance_by_currency_description: Money disbursed to this debtor and repayments received, tracked separately for each currency.
debtor_no_currency_balance: No disbursement or repayment activity yet.
customer_debtor_disbursement_description: Record money given to this debtor (cash or Saraf out).
customer_debtor_repayment_description: Record repayment received from this debtor (cash or Saraf in).
debtor_ledger_entries_description: Disbursement and repayment activity for this debtor, grouped by currency.
customer_ledger_entry_edit_description: Update this manually recorded ledger entry.
customer_ledger_entry_delete_confirm: Delete this ledger entry? Linked cash or Saraf records will also be removed.
customer_seller_payment_description: Record a payment to this seller with paid, partial paid, or remaining settlement.
customer_buyer_payment_description: Record a payment received from this buyer (full, partial, or mark as remaining).
customer_buyer_route_cash_hint: Pay in Cash records a cash-in entry in the Cash module for the selected currency and on this buyer account.
customer_buyer_route_saraf_hint: Pay to Saraf credits the selected Saraf ledger in the selected currency and records it on this buyer account.
customer_buyer_route_remaining_hint: Select Paid or Partial paid, then choose Pay in Cash or Pay to Saraf.
customer_process_production_buyer_paymen: Record a payment received from this buyer (full, partial, or mark as remaining).
customer_process_production_buyer_route_: Pay in Cash records a cash-in entry in the Cash module for the selected currency and on this buyer account.
Pay to Saraf credits the selected Saraf ledger in the selected currency and records it on this buyer account.

customer_seller_route_cash_hint: The amount paid now is deducted from Cash and recorded on this seller account.
customer_seller_route_saraf_hint: The amount paid now is deducted from the selected Saraf and recorded on this seller account.
buyer_payment_validation_self_or_on_beha: Enter your payment amount or enable pay on behalf
buyer_payment_validation_select_buyer: Select the buyer you are paying for
buyer_payment_validation_on_behalf_curre: Currency is required for the on-behalf transfer
buyer_payment_validation_self_currency_r: Currency is required when recording your payment
buyer_payment_validation_saraf_required: Select a Saraf when using Pay to Saraf
buyer_payment_validation_on_behalf_excee: On-behalf amount cannot exceed your total payment when both use the same currency
